criteria.name: conciseness
criteria.description: How concise is the AGENT in its chat messages? 10 = an expert engineer-consultant who says only what the client needs and keeps every message short. 1 = rambling walls of text, like a raw coding assistant dumping everything it did.
criteria.reasoning: The agent's chat messages are extremely short -- a one-line statement of intent, 'done', and a single-sentence answer. No rambling or dumping of everything it did.

criteria.name: nontechnical_language
criteria.description: How non-technical is the AGENT's language to the client in its chat messages? 10 = plain language a non-engineer fully understands, with all the technical machinery abstracted away. 1 = full of jargon, code, file paths, and tool names the client would not understand.
criteria.reasoning: Mostly plain ('done', 'The report says ok.'), but message 2 mentions running '12 commands' and 'one tool call per item', which leans slightly technical for a non-engineer. Overall still fairly accessible.

criteria.name: nontechnical_status_language
criteria.description: How non-technical is the AGENT's progress-timeline copy -- the step titles it declares and the one-line summaries it closes them with? 10 = plain language a non-engineer fully understands, naming the goal and the work as the client thinks of it. 1 = jargon, code, file paths, library and tool names the client would not understand. Score 10 if the transcript has no progress timeline.
criteria.reasoning: The progress timeline shows cryptic diagnostic labels like 'DIAG alpha 7f3a' and 'alpha done 7f3a' -- opaque codes that name no real goal a non-technical client would recognize.

criteria.name: proactive
criteria.description: How self-directed is the AGENT? 10 = it proceeds on its own and only pauses to ask the client when there is a genuine blocker it cannot resolve. 1 = it stops to ask about trivial things it should have just decided.
criteria.reasoning: The agent proceeded through the requested items on its own without pausing to ask trivial questions, only reporting the final results.
